title: API6 six completed-race gap source coverage recheck
scope: Read-only recheck of the six keys in completed_missing_source_keys.csv against immutable complete-year API6_1 artifacts, read-only DB API6/API303/API4 source rows. No external API calls or database writes.

source_artifact_coverage.year_scope: meet=2, rc_year=2025 and 2026; every page enumerated by source year manifest; totalCount=actual row sum=manifest count; requested-year rcDate scope all rows; page SHA-256, byte count, and row count reverified.

source_key_vs_field_missingness: For each target, exact (rcDate, rcNo) row match count is 0 in the corresponding complete annual API6 artifact. This is a race-level source-key absence in archived API6 responses, not an existing row whose API6 fields are blank/null. API6 has no horse ID; API4 horse-level section rows are a separate source.
api303_api4_review_note: API303 exists at the race key and API4 has all returned horse-level result rows. Reported API303/API4 field pairings are only the audit mapping (corner_7↔sjS1fOrd, corner_1↔sj_1cOrd, corner_2↔sj_2cOrd, corner_3↔sj_3cOrd, corner_4↔sj_4cOrd, corner_8↔sjG1fOrd); these are conservative rank-range checks, not asserted definitions or automatic corrections. API303 passing-time fields are retained independently; no unit/definition equivalence is assumed against horse-level API4 times.
